subject: Request: approval for pilot discount + liability carveout (Helion Systems)
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@helionsystems.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@helionsystems.com>, procure@helionsystems.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot SOW and commercial terms - redlines attached

Laura — thanks for the call this morning. Attached are our redlines to the SOW and the master (Helion_SOW_v3_redlines.pdf). The main asks from our side are:

- Pilot discount: 40% off list for a 6-month pilot (we'll commit to a proof-of-concept and a reference if successful).
- Liability cap: reduce Redwood's cap to $250,000 for the pilot period (we pushed hard here given the pilot scope).
- Indemnity: remove the requirement for Helion to indemnify Redwood for third-party IP claims stemming from Helion-supplied artifacts; we are open to a mutual IP indemnity but not one-sided exposure.
- Warranty: shorten the warranty window to 45 days and add an acceptance test pass requirement.

We also attached a short summary of our procurement requirements. Can you confirm whether Redwood can agree to these items? We need a response by COB Friday (10/15) to keep procurement engaged.

Thanks,

Maria Gonzalez
Director, Cloud Programs
Helion Systems

Attachment: Helion_SOW_v3_redlines.pdf
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@helionsystems.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot SOW and commercial terms - redlines attached

Maria — thanks, received and reviewed quickly. Appreciate the transparency on the ask and the timeline.

Quick summary of what I'll escalate internally: pilot discount (40%), liability cap move to $250k for pilot window, and the indemnity carveout request. Legal and Deal Desk will need to weigh in — I'm looping them now.

Next steps:
- Ben (Deal Desk) and Aditya (Legal) — can you review Helion's redlines and the SOW attachment and confirm what we can accept vs. where we need to push back?
- Marissa — FYI for renewal/expansion playbook if this goes through.

We should aim to give Helion a firm answer by COB Friday (10/15) — if that won't be possible, I'll ask Maria for a little runway.

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot SOW and commercial terms - redlines attached

Laura / team — reviewed the redlines and the numbers. My read and suggested commercial compromise: 

- Discount: push back from 40% to 25% for the pilot with a clear expansion milestone (MRR target or reference commitment) that triggers standard pricing after 6 months.
- Liability cap: cannot accept $250k as a hard floor for enterprise pilots. Proposed: $500k aggregate cap for the pilot period, with a $1M carveout limited strictly to consumer/production data breaches (i.e., security incident caused by Redwood). Put a sunset on the lower cap at the end of the pilot.
- Indemnity: decline wholesale removal of indemnity. Suggest mutual IP indemnity with Redwood's exposure limited to direct damages and capped per the liability cap. Add an explicit third-party IP claim process (notice, cure period).
- Warranty: acceptance window OK; agree to 45 days for pilot acceptance testing.

I've attached a pricing spreadsheet with modeled ARR impact for the 25% vs 40% scenarios. If approved, I can produce the commercial amendment and a short mutual carveout clause for Legal to insert.

Ben Carter
Senior Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: helion_pricing_spread_v3.xlsx
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot SOW and commercial terms - redlines attached (legal position)

Team — read the redlines and Ben's suggested compromise. Legal's position below (short):

- Indemnity: we cannot accept a blanket removal of Helion's indemnity obligations. We can, however, offer a mutual IP indemnity limited to direct damages and with a standard notice/cure process. We should expressly exclude open-source license claims from Redwood's indemnity obligation.
- Liability cap: company policy requires escalation for caps below $500k. I will accept a $500k aggregate cap for the pilot period as an exception subject to Priya's approval, and with a $1M limited carveout specifically for data breach liabilities tied to Redwood's negligence. That carveout must be narrowly written (security event defined + timeline).
- Warranty: 45-day acceptance period is acceptable. Add a discrete acceptance test plan in the SOW.

I attached the MAMLA redline excerpt with suggested language (Helion-MAMLA-REDLINE.docx). If we go with Ben's 25% discount + the $500k/$1M carveout structure and the mutual IP indemnity language, Legal would approve the amendment. Anything more concessionary requires executive sign-off.

Aditya Rao
VP, Legal | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachment: Helion-MAMLA-REDLINE.docx
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request — Helion pilot exception (discount + liability carveout)

Priya — requesting executive approval for an exception on the Helion pilot deal (see thread below and attachments). Summary for decision: 

Background:
- Helion (HSN-2026-042) is asking for a 6-month pilot with a 40% discount and a $250k liability cap. Potential expansion ARR is ~ $1.2M if pilot converts; strategic value: enterprise reference in GovTech vertical. Procurement needs a yes/no by 10/15 (they gave a tight window).

Legal and Deal Desk recommended compromise (what I'm asking you to approve):
- Approve pilot discount of 25% (instead of 40%).
- Approve exception to liability cap: $500k aggregate cap for the pilot period with a narrowly scoped $1M carveout for customer data breach caused by Redwood's negligence.
- Accept mutual IP indemnity limited to direct damages + standard notice/cure; exclude open-source license claims from Redwood's indemnity.
- Warranty: 45-day acceptance test and SOW-defined acceptance criteria.
- Commercial conditions: Helion must provide an executive reference and agree to a 6-month automatic review; pilot pricing reverts to standard unless expansion milestones are met.

Rationale: Helion is a strategic early adopter in our target GovTech segment; the $25% concession plus the limited liability carveout keeps our risk within acceptable bounds while materially improving conversion probability. Legal has drafted language; Deal Desk has modeled revenue impact (attached).

Requested action: Please reply with APPROVE or DECLINE. If you would like a narrower or broader carveout, tell us the parameters. If APPROVE, Ben will finalize the commercial amendment and Aditya will sign the legal addendum.

Attachments: Helion_SOW_v3_redlines.pdf; Helion-MAMLA-REDLINE.docx; helion_pricing_spread_v3.xlsx

Thanks — I can be on call if you want a short readout.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
From: priya.natarajan@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — Helion pilot exception (discount + liability carveout)

Laura — APPROVE the recommendation.

Conditions: 1) We keep the $500k aggregate pilot cap with the $1M security carveout narrowly written as legal proposed; 2) 25% pilot discount only; 3) include an explicit 6-month sunset and a written reference commitment before the pilot begins.

Ben/Aditya — proceed to finalize docs. Thank you.

Priya Natarajan
CEO | Redwood Inference
